place_text: Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico

as_told.title: HD release shows the Holloman 'landing' footage is a plane
as_told.place_text: Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico

plain: The story is that a piece of film said to show a UFO landing at Holloman Air Force Base in New Mexico turned out, on a closer look, to show an ordinary plane. The footage appears in the documentary UFOs: Past, Present and Future, released in 1974. Michels says so himself: 'there's also a little bit of footage and that footage has now been debunked as an F-4,' an American fighter jet. A narrator of a documentary played in a later episode explains how. A new high-definition DVD of the old film 'was a game changer,' he says. When he skipped to the landing footage, he 'was momentarily stunned by what that extra detail revealed.' He calls the object only a plane and does not say what kind. For those who believe a landing took place, it means one piece of claimed proof falls away, even if the wider story does not.
